name: Della Mercer
source_profile: ● Della Mercer (CG) is a celebrated trail boss and veteran cattle driver who commands considerable loyalty among Four-Spur's drovers. She is known for her extraordinary horsemanship and willingness to defy company orders when they place her riders or neighboring communities in unnecessary danger.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 44 (source excerpt; may be partial)
